SIKAGROUT®-9500: SPECIFICATION CLAUSE SET

Source: SikaGrout®-9500, October 2025, Version 03.01 (https://aus.sika.com/content/dam/dms/au01/s/sikagrout-9500.pdf)
Draft for specifier review. Wording, values and standards are quoted from that data sheet; where it is silent the clause says 'Refer to manufacturer.' Confirm the current edition before issue.

1 SCOPE
1.1 Work included. Provide SikaGrout®-9500 where documented, installed or applied in accordance with this clause and the manufacturer's Product Data Sheet (October 2025, Version 03.01).
1.2 Product description. SikaGrout®-9500 is a shrinkage compensated, cement based grout which when mixed with water, produces a homogeneous, flowable and pumpable grout with exceptionally high early and final strength and modulus. Latest best binder packing models and applied cementitious nanotechnology produces a grout with superior technical performance, exceptional rheological properties, and, uniquely, extended open times.
1.3 Intended uses stated by the manufacturer. SikaGrout®-9500 has been especially formulated for large scale, pump applications.
    - Grouting of wind turbine installations, e.g. foundations, monopiles, transition pieces of wind towers, where very good fatigue resistance is required.
    - Grouting under very harsh conditions, e.g. offshore applications or below water grouting, at temperatures as low as 0°C.
    - All void filling from 25mm to 600mm thickness where high strength, high modulus is important (in other applications or where void dimensions of 10 - 25 mm are to be filled contact our technical department).
    Contact the Technical Department of your local
    Sika office regarding any application required not mentioned here.

2 MATERIALS
2.1 Product. SikaGrout®-9500
    - Product type as printed on the data sheet: Ultra-high strength, high modulus, cement based grout with applied nanotechnology for grouting offshore wind turbine installations
    - Supplier as printed on the data sheet: Sika Australia Pty Limited, ABN 12 001 342 329, aus.sika.com, Tel: 1300 22 33 48
2.2 Approvals, certificates and standards stated by the manufacturer - Dnv-validation. DNV Type Approval Certificate number: TAK00000T1 The certification programme for SikaGrout®-9500, which is the basis for issuing the DNV product certificate, comprised the following main activities:
    - Validation and acceptance of test methodology, procedures and extent of testing
    - Evaluation and acceptance of the external, independent testing laboratory for testing properties
    - of SikaGrout®-9500
    - Witnessing and acceptance of the laboratory tests, and the reporting thereof
    - Evaluation and witnessing of mock-up tests, and large scale pumping trials, and the acceptance of the reporting thereof
    - Audit, evaluation and acceptance of grout manufacturing equipment and facilities
    - Audit, evaluation and acceptance of Sika’s internal laboratory with respect to production quality control of SikaGrout®-9500
    - Evaluation and acceptance of results of the tests and trials carried out to demonstrate the materials suitability for use in offshore applications, such as grouted connections of monopile foundations for offshore wind turbines or similar.
    - The validation and certification related to the above mentioned activities are carried out in accordance with applicable EN-standards and DNV-OS-C502 (Offshore concrete structures)
2.3 Approvals, certificates and standards stated by the manufacturer - Fatigue resistance.
    - Certified by DNV-OS-C502. More detailed results are available on request.
2.4 Standards and test methods cited in the data sheet. Cited as written in the data sheet. A citation is not a statement that the product complies with it; conformity is stated only where the data sheet says so (see the approvals clause and the statements quoted in the other clauses).
    - EN1504-6: cited elsewhere in the data sheet. Where: Features (p.1).
    - EN 12390-3: test method printed beside a stated value. Where: Technical Information > Compressive strength (p.2).
    - EN 206: test method printed beside a stated value. Where: Technical Information > Compressive strength (p.2).
    - EN 13412: test method printed beside a stated value. Where: Technical Information > Modulus of elasticity in compression (p.2).
    - EN 196-1: test method printed beside a stated value. Where: Technical Information > Flexural-strength (p.2).
    - EN 1881: test method printed beside a stated value. Where: Technical Information > Pull-out resistance (p.2).
    - ASTM C1698: test method printed beside a stated value. Where: Technical Information > Shrinkage (p.2).
    - EN 13057: test method printed beside a stated value. Where: Technical Information > Capillary absorption (p.2).
    - EN 12390-6: test method printed beside a stated value. Where: Technical Information > Splitting tensile strength (p.2).
2.5 Characteristics stated by the manufacturer.
    - Certified by Det Norske Veritas (DNV)
    - Ultra-high mean compressive strength ≥135MPa.
    - Ultra-high modulus for exceptional stiffening properties.
    - Very good fatigue resistance.
    - Quick return to service and removal of temporary supports due to high early strength build-up. ≥ 60 MPa at 24hours under 20°C
    - Excellent strength gain at low temperatures at 24 hours under 0°C
    - No segregation or bleeding to ensure consistent final physical performance and to prevent pump blockages
    - No wash-out during below water grouting
    - Pump able over long distances and large heights.
    - Extended pot life of ≥ 4 hours
    - Specially graded sands and exceptional flow and low friction increases pump output, reduces installation times and costs as well as reducing pump pressures and wear
    - Dust reduced for ease of handling and safety of workers
    - Available in special, watertight big bags for large scale application.
    - Meets the requirements of EN1504-6 for anchoring reinforcement bars.
2.6 Composition, appearance and supply.
    - Density: Approximately 2.4 gr/cm³
2.7 Properties stated by the manufacturer.
    - Pull-out resistance: ≤ 0.6 mm displacement at 75 kN load (EN 1881)
    - Capillary absorption: ≤ 0.05 kg/m².h-0.5 (EN 13057)
    - Ring test: no cracking after 180 days

2.13 Packaging, shelf life and storage.
    - Packaging: SikaGrout®-9500 is supplied in special 25 kg and 1000, 1250, 1500 kg watertight big bags.
    - Shelf life: 12 months from date of production
    - Storage conditions: Product must be stored in original, unopened and undamaged sealed packaging in dry conditions.

3 SUBSTRATE PREPARATION
3.1 Substrate preparation. Refer to manufacturer. The data sheet reviewed (October 2025, Version 03.01) states no substrate preparation requirements.

4 APPLICATION
4.1 General. Apply in accordance with the manufacturer's Product Data Sheet (October 2025, Version 03.01) and the requirements below.
4.2 Application data.
    - Mixing ratio: Approx. 75 lt / 1000 kg powder (min. 70 lt- max. 80 lt)
    - Consumption: Approximately 2.2 kg powder is needed for 1 litre of mixed mortar. Or, 1000 kg powder will yield approximately 450 to 465 litre of mixed grout.
    - Layer thickness: 25 - 600 mm
    - Pot Life: ≥ 4 hours
    - Setting time: ≤ 10 hours
4.3 Notes on installation.
    - SikaGrout®-9500 has been especially formulated for use in specific applications. As such SikaGrout®-9500 should be installed by experienced fully trained contractors. Full application procedures are available on request.
    - Sands or other products that could affect the products properties must not be added.
    - SikaGrout®-9500 which will be exposed to strong drying conditions, e.g. mortar which is directly exposed to heavy wind and/or direct sunlight, should be protected using appropriate curing agents.
    - Independent test reports are available on request.
4.4 Further documentation.
    - Sika Method Statement: SikaGrout®-9500

5 QUALITY CONTROL AND TESTING
5.1 Hold point. Before each application, measure and record the conditions in clause 5.2 and compare them with the manufacturer's limits. HOLD POINT: do not proceed until the Superintendent has released the hold point.
5.2 Material temperature. 0 °C min. / +30 °C max. (grouted connection)
5.3 Ambient air temperature. 0 °C min. / +30 °C max. (grouted connection)
5.4 Substrate temperature. 0 °C min. / +30 °C max. (grouted connection)
5.5 Trials, test areas and compatibility checks stated by the manufacturer.
    - Evaluation and witnessing of mock-up tests, and large scale pumping trials, and the acceptance of the reporting thereof
5.6 Test methods printed beside stated values. Each value is as printed in the data sheet with its test method.
    - Compressive strength: Age | 20 oC | 10 oC | 5 oC | 2 oC; (N/mm²); 1 day | ≥ 60 | ≥ 15; 2 days | ≥ 80 | ≥ 60 | ≥ 35 | ≥ 25; 3 days | ≥ 95 | ≥ 85 | ≥ 65 | ≥ 45; 7 days | ≥ 120 | ≥ 120 | ≥ 85 | ≥ 60; 28 days | ≥ 135; Results of 75 mm cubes; Exposure classes; XO, XC4, XD3, XS2, XS3, XF3, XA2, WA (EN 12390-3) (EN 206)
    - Modulus of elasticity in compression: GPa | 20 oC; 28 days | 49.9 (EN 13412)
    - Flexural-strength: N/mm² | 20 oC | 2 oC; 28 days | ≥ 15 | ≥ 12 (EN 196-1)
    - Pull-out resistance: ≤ 0.6 mm displacement at 75 kN load (EN 1881)
    - Shrinkage: Age | mm/m; after 7 days | - 0.0146; after 94 days | - 0.0455; after 365 days | + 0.0006; Autogenous shrinkage: (ASTM C1698)
    - Capillary absorption: ≤ 0.05 kg/m².h-0.5 (EN 13057)
    - Splitting tensile strength: Age | 20 oC; after 28 days | ≥ 8 N/mm²; Results of 100 x 200 mm cylinders (EN 12390-6)
5.7 Basis of the stated values. All technical data stated in this Product Data Sheet are based on laboratory tests. Actual measured data may vary due to circumstances beyond our control.
5.8 Other tests. For any test method, sampling frequency or acceptance criterion not stated in this clause: refer to manufacturer and the project specification.

6 WARRANTY AND DOCUMENTATION
6.1 Documents to be obtained and submitted. Obtain the current issue of each document before ordering and submit it with the product submission. Documents are listed as published on the manufacturer's website.
    - Product Data Sheet: SikaGrout®-9500, October 2025, Version 03.01, https://aus.sika.com/content/dam/dms/au01/s/sikagrout-9500.pdf
6.2 Ecology, health and safety. For information and advice on the safe handling, storage and disposal of chemical products, users shall refer to the most recent Safety Data Sheet (SDS) containing physical, ecological, toxicological and other safety-related data.
6.3 Maintenance - Cleaning. Tools and spillages can be cleaned with water while SikaGrout®-9500 is still uncured. Once hardened, the material can only be removed mechanically.
6.4 Warranty. Obtain any product or installation warranty in writing from the manufacturer or its authorised applicator and file it with the project records. Warranty terms: refer to manufacturer.
    - Legal notes: In practice, the differences in materials, substrates and actual site conditions are such that no warranty in respect of merchantability or of fitness for a particular purpose, nor any liability arising out of any legal relationship whatsoever, can be inferred either from this information, or from any written recommendations, or from any other advice offered.
6.5 Local restrictions. Please note that as a result of specific local regulations the declared data for this product may vary from country to country. Please consult the local Product Data Sheet for the exact product data.
6.6 Application records. Record the product name, batch numbers, dates, areas treated and the conditions measured under clause 5.2, and include the records in the project documentation.
